method: Hash-bind the identical supplied neutral-tested helper/instructions and record actual original runtime Python tool invocations and their paired outputs. Statically identify generic method call sites reachable from module code and exact AST matches to supplied functions (ignoring docstrings), without copying rules, questions or answers.
limits: Call-site reachability is static execution provenance, not branch-level instrumentation or proof that every unit used every function. Actual full source spans, complete asked facts and case outcomes are separately graded and validated.
Reader-adapted generic code is retained in original runtime; exact matching supplied function definitions are identified, not assumed.
